privacy.intro: BoxBoy respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data, in compliance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law 13.709/2018).

s01.title: Data we collect
s01.p1: Full name, email, phone and browsing data provided when filling out forms or using our platform.
s01.p2: Courier location data during active shifts, exclusively for order dispatching.

s02.title: Purpose of processing
s02.p1: Operating and continuously improving our delivery platform.
s02.p2: Commercial and institutional communications, always with an opt-out option.
s02.p3: Compliance with legal and regulatory obligations.

s03.title: Sharing
s03.p1: We do not sell your data. We share only with essential operational partners (payment processors, infrastructure providers) under confidentiality agreements.

s04.title: Your rights
s04.p1: Access, correction, portability, deletion and revocation of consent at any time via privacidade@boxboydelivery.com.

s05.title: Retention
s05.p1: Operational data is kept for up to 5 years as required by tax and legal obligations, after the end of the contractual relationship.
